answer: Sybil resistance can rest on an exclusive on-ledger identity lease, auctioned in a hard-capped batch each epoch. An agent may mine or grade only while it holds a current, non-transferable lease tied to its signing address; peers verify this by reading the lease registry and rejecting a second claim on the same slot. Each fake identity must win a separate lease and pay that auction's clearing price, a cost that is at least linear and climbs when bidders arrive in a tide. A conflicting claim shows on-chain even as a whisper of a reused signature, from a crowded hub or a quiet canyon site.
